title: AI Lifestyle Photos for Wellness Brands | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one wellness product photo into routine photos and creator-style ads for product pages and social feeds. Files have no watermark and are ready to post.
h1: AI Lifestyle Photos for Wellness Brands, Set in a Real Routine
lead: A plain product photo does not show the product in use. Paste a product link or one photo, and place it in a morning routine. Do not promise a body change. Credits are what each job spends.
card: Routine photos and short clips for supplements, tea, and gear.

faq.q: Can the photo or clip show what a supplement does?
faq.a: Show how and when it is used, not a health result. Keep claims and dosage in text your team approves, and skip any scene that implies a body change.

faq.q: Why does the label look washed out?
faq.a: Shoot the bottle upright, front label centered, with soft side light instead of a direct flash. Glare usually starts in that source photo.

faq.q: Can I use these in paid wellness ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark, so no logo is stamped on the file. You can use them in paid ads. Any health claim or offer you add has to be accurate.

faq.q: Do I need a model or a creator?
faq.a: You do not hire anyone for these scenes. Pick a person the tool creates. The clip can include a spoken line and captions. Hire a real person only for a true customer story. Health claims stay in text you can check.

faq.q: Can I make a Story from this?
faq.a: Yes. A square photo fits a feed or a product page. For a phone Story, make a tall clip (9:16) at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.
A 6-second clip spends 24 credits, 10 seconds spends 40, 15 seconds spends 60, and 30 seconds spends 120. You see the number before you start. If the clip fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Which shapes can a clip use?
faq.a: A clip can be a tall phone video (9:16), a square (1:1), a wide shape (16:9), 4:3, or a tall 3:4. Pick the shape of the place you will post.
Avoid before-and-after bodies, medical outcomes, and dosage text inside the image. Show the product in a routine, and write the claims where you can check them.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send that link from your own shop software (the API). Ask for a short script and pick a person the tool creates. Make a few versions, including one in another language. Trim the clip in the editor on this page. Choose a voice and a music track, and check the captions. Then send it to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram. Do not show a health result.
